memories.memory: I was diagnosed with high blood pressure in November 2023 after repeated readings around 155/92, and I now take amlodipine 5 mg every morning.
A workplace fall in February 2022 damaged my right knee, and I still use a compression brace when I have to stand during long public meetings.
I get migraine episodes about once every two months, usually with light sensitivity and nausea, and my doctor prescribed sumatriptan 50 mg for them.
A sleep study at North Cedar Medical Centre last year showed moderate obstructive sleep apnea, so I use a CPAP machine most nights.
I completed eight sessions of physiotherapy for recurring lower-back pain between April and June 2024, which helped me return to lifting equipment at work.
After several months of persistent stomach pain, an ultrasound in August 2025 found gallstones, and I am waiting for a surgical consultation rather than treating the symptoms with painkillers alone.
I was prescribed sertraline 25 mg for anxiety during a particularly stressful period in 2021, but I stopped taking it after three months because it made me feel emotionally flat.
